messages:
derek (Procure): FYI vendor 'MeterMap' sent renewal + a weird invoice split. They include a 'reseller fee' line and separate VAT handling. Need procurement + finance eyes.

 sylvie (Finance): Can you paste the invoice lines? we need to model landed cost (VAT + reseller) and also confirm billing entity (EU vs US).

 derek (Procure): Key lines: service commit $27,500; overage $0.013/1k; reseller fee $1,200/mo; VAT listed at 20% but invoice shows vendor as UK entity. Also they propose billing to a partner account in EU for 'faster onboarding'.

 omar (GTM Sales): If they're routing through a reseller, check whether that affects our SSO/integration or data residency. Also will it add complexity for our internal PO workflow?

 frank (Legal): Two asks: 1) confirm which legal entity will sign (we prefer direct vendor invoicing to avoid reseller opacity), 2) supplier tax docs (VAT registration number) and warranty of correct VAT handling. No reseller unless due diligence done.

 billing-bot: BillingOps note: last MeterMap invoice INV-2026-05 included a reseller line and we had to manually reallocate. Ticket #1901 open for mapping.

 sylvie (Finance): Modeling: with 20% VAT + reseller fee, landed monthly cost rises ~26%. Need clarity before commit. Derek 1 ask vendor: can they invoice Redwood UK/EU directly or supply VAT-exempt reverse-charge invoice? Also confirm whether reseller takes commissions that change overage rate.

 derek (Procure): Messaged sales: "Can you confirm invoicing entity, VAT reg number, whether reseller is required or optional, and whether reseller fees affect unit rates or just a line-item? Also provide sample MSA with reseller clause removed."

 vendor-sales (MeterMap): Reply: "We can invoice either MeterMap Ltd (UK) or MeterMap Inc (US). Reseller is optional for enterprise EU deployments; reseller fee is a separate pass-through and doesn't change per-token rates. We will provide VAT reg and sample MSA."

 frank (Legal): Good start. If we go through reseller we need visibility into pass-through margins and right to request original vendor docs. Add contract language: reseller must disclose markup and vendor must indemnify us for any incorrect tax treatment.

 omar (GTM Sales): Also check approval path: if invoice lands EU entity we need EOR/PO adjustments. Derek 1 ensure procurement raises PO to correct legal entity to avoid delays in payment and tax reclaim.

 sylvie (Finance): I'll draft pro-forma with both scenarios (direct vendor vs reseller) and post by EOD. If vendor can issue reverse-charge invoices and direct invoice to our EU entity, landed cost will be materially lower and commit may be OK.

 derek (Procure): TL;DR: hold signing until vendor confirms entity + VAT docs + optional reseller disclosure. If reseller is mandatory or markup opaque, push for direct invoicing or walk away from commit.
